owner only indexes the allowance read performed by allowance()
spender only indexes the allowance read performed by allowance()

amount is only meaningful as the allowance value set by approve()
sender indexes the balance decremented without checks inside _transfer()
recipient indexes the balance incremented without checks inside _transfer()
